# WHAT THE HOUSE — Home Inspection Chiang Mai (บริการตรวจบ้านเชียงใหม่)

> WHAT THE HOUSE is an independent, professional home and condominium inspection service in Chiang Mai, Lamphun and Lampang, Thailand. We inspect properties before handover (or before purchase), covering structure, architecture, electrical, plumbing, sanitary and roofing systems, and deliver a bilingual (Thai–English) PDF report with photos. Fully independent — no ties to any developer or contractor. Slogan: BETTER HOMES • BETTER LIVING / บ้านที่ดีกว่า เพื่อชีวิตที่ดีกว่า.

## Key facts
- Service area: Chiang Mai, Lamphun, Lampang (เชียงใหม่ ลำพูน ลำปาง)
- Languages: Thai and English (bilingual PDF report in one document)
- Report delivery: within 24 hours of the inspection
- Inspection method: non-destructive, covers all safely accessible areas and systems
- Standard package includes 2 inspection rounds (first inspection + one follow-up re-inspection); a cheaper single-round package is also available
- Opening hours: every day, 08:00–20:00
- Contact: phone 065-429-9878, email whatthehouse.official@gmail.com, LINE and Facebook Messenger

## Pricing (starting prices, include 2 rounds + bilingual PDF report)
- Condominium: from 3,000 THB (by usable area)
- Single-storey house: from 5,000 THB
- Two-storey / semi-detached house: from 6,000 THB
- Townhome / townhouse: from 5,000 THB
- Priced by usable area and property type; special systems (pool, lift, solar) and second-hand properties may add to the price. Full self-service price calculator and instant PDF quotation at the pricing page.
